title: vionix-cicd context envelope v1
description: One versioned document passed between the jobs of a vionix-cicd pipeline: a readable `plain` part (YAML expressions can read it — never secrets) and an AES-256-GCM `sealed` part keyed by CONFIG_STREAM_KEY. Produced/validated by actions/build/cicd-context/context.ts.

org.description: github.repository_owner of the run that sealed it

githubHost.description: host of GITHUB_SERVER_URL (github.com or a GHES host)

additionalProperties.description: a namespaced readable section (registry, image, scan, attest, …), append-only

sealed.description: base64(iv[12] | tag[16] | AES-256-GCM(canonical JSON of {section: {NAME: string}})); AAD = canonical {schema, version, plain, trail}
